text:
oliver: deploy-bot paused promotion for v2026.03.23-rc5. preflight failing at release-notes step: strict-validator exit 1. anyone seen logs?
deploy-bot: [automated] Promotion paused for build v2026.03.23-rc5: preflight step `release-notes.strict-validator` failed. Run `/deploybot inspect 3140000007` for details.
nina: I pulled the log. Validator is rejecting entries where commit has no author.email or if email is unverified. snippet:
```
ERROR strict-validator: commit 7e9a1b: missing author.email
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tools/notes_validator.py", line 58, in validate_commit
    email = commit['author']['email']
KeyError: 'email'
```
harpreet: looks like a couple of external PR merges lost the email metadata. two choices: (A) synth emails and mark them, (B) attach a hand-written notes file and request SOC sign-off for enterprise customers, (C) quick tool patch to fallback to inferred email when missing.
oliver: product/pm, compliance implications?
pm-erin: enterprise requirement is that release metadata include a contact. Synthesized emails are allowed if annotated and ticketed. Manual skip requires SOC approval and will delay cut if outside the change window.
security-bot: change window closes in 22m. Manual promotions after window need SOC approval. Also flag: if email is unverified, legal wants an annotation.
nina: I can run a safe fallback patch: tool will infer email as first.last@redwood.ai for internal contributors and add tag `(inferred)` next to entry. That avoids manual notes and keeps pipeline intact. quick patch + preflight re-run ~8m.
harpreet: agree, but add a header `x-inferred-authors: true` so downstream audit filters pick it up. Also log the mapping.
oliver: what's the risk? are we changing behavior of a core preflight step?
nina: only for missing emails; validator still fails for suspicious domains. We'll keep a strict whitelist. I’ll run in a feature-flagged way and revert after cut.
pm-erin: product okay with inferred emails annotated. Ensure we post the synthesized mapping in #release-review for signoff.
harpreet: if SOC pushes back, fallback plan is to pin the promotion to v2026.03.22 and open a hotfix release with cleaned commits.
nina: applying patch now, re-running preflight.
nina: posted mapping file to #release-review and re-ran preflight. logs:
```
release-notes: inferred emails added for 5 commits (marked `(inferred)`).
preflight: WARNING: inferred author emails present.
preflight: PASS
```
harpreet: good. oliver, want me to run promote? use normal promote flow and attach the notes artifact.
oliver: yes, go ahead. do not use skip flags. keep tag unchanged.
harpreet: running:
``
deploy-bot promote --build v2026.03.23-rc5 --notes /tmp/rc5_notes_inferred.md
```
deploy-bot: Promotion started for build v2026.03.23-rc5. Preflight: PASS. Canary rollout ETA ~6m.
security-bot: Monitoring and audit write check enabled for 15m post-rollout. Remember to open SOC ticket with mapping artifact.
pm-erin: watching release-review thread for any product edit requests.
harpreet: canaries passing at 4m. no regressions.
nina: will clean up the feature flag and open PR to add a formal inference step with annotations for future runs.
oliver: thanks everyone. harpreet, please file the SOC ticket and note the inferred mappings. closing thread 97 cut successful.
